headline: Meta contractor contaminates city water with metal-resistant bacterium, discharge privileges revoked
summary: A rare, metal-resistant bacterium from a Meta data center's cooling system purge disrupted Cheyenne's water reclamation plants for months.
details: The Cheyenne Board of Public Utilities has revoked discharge privileges from Goat Systems LLC, Meta's contractor, after a rare bacterium was traced to its data center operations. This bacterium contaminated the city's reclaimed water system.

The bacterium, identified as Cupriavidus gilardii, is metal-resistant and interfered with two water reclamation plants, forcing the reuse system offline for months of cleanup. The contamination occurred during a 'fill-and-flush' commissioning step for a closed-loop cooling system.

Goat Systems routed the flush water, containing the bacterium, into Cheyenne's sanitary sewer. While the origin of the bacterium remains unknown, lab staff detected it in February during routine fecal-bacteria sampling, though it's not typically tested for.

Beyond the bacterium, the Board expressed concern that closed-loop systems can carry glycol and other chemicals that municipal treatment plants are not designed to process. There was also worry the bacterium could become an aerosol hazard during irrigation of parks and golf courses.

Meta stated it is supporting its general contractor, Fortis, which has stopped discharging wastewater and is now hauling it offsite. Independent testing has reportedly found no trace of the substance, and the city's reuse system is back online as of late June.

headline: iOS 27 beta 2 hints at AirPods Pro with cameras
summary: Developer Sam Henri Gold discovered references in the latest iOS 27 beta, suggesting Apple is working on a new AirPods Pro model featuring integrated cameras.
details: References to a new Apple product, codenamed, have been discovered within iOS 27 beta 2 by developer Sam Henri Gold. The findings specifically point towards an upcoming AirPods Pro model that could feature integrated cameras.

While details remain scarce, the integration of cameras into AirPods Pro could open up new possibilities for augmented reality experiences, health tracking, or even advanced spatial computing interactions.

As these are only hints found in a beta version of iOS, Apple has not officially confirmed any such product. Future beta releases or official announcements will be needed to provide more concrete information.
